description: This file implements a service class `OpenAIChatService` that interacts with the OpenAI Chat Completions API, including error handling, request formation, and response parsing. It also defines related error enums and exception classes.

classes.name: ChatGPTError
classes.description: An enumeration of possible errors from the OpenAI API, including invalid URL, invalid response, and no content.

classes.name: ChatGPTException
classes.description: Exception class wrapping ChatGPTError, providing a human-readable message.

classes.name: OpenAIChatService
classes.description: A service class that sends chat messages to the OpenAI API and processes the responses, implementing the ChatService interface.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a list of ChatMessage objects to the OpenAI API and returns the assistant's reply content as a string.
